name: LLM Agent Chat
description: LLM-backed transition function for agents. The default and recommended choice for plain persona-style chat agents (customer support, character agents, summarisers, etc.) — for hierarchical goal decomposition with subgoal/complete/fail/compact tools, use v/ops/goaltree/chat instead. Conversation history lives on the agent's sessions; configuration (llmOperation, model, systemPrompt, url) arrives via 'config'. Invokes the configured level 3 grid operation for LLM calls — credentials are resolved by the level 3 operation from the user's secret store.

state.description: Previous runtime state (null on first run) — loads and other runtime data. Configuration (llmOperation, model, systemPrompt) arrives separately via 'config' (#144).

messages.description: Inbox messages to process as user turns

config.description: Agent config at fire time: llmOperation, model, systemPrompt, tools, caps (#144)

session.description: The session this cycle runs in

newInput.description: Continuation input delivered to the picked task since the last cycle

jobId.description: The cycle's job id, for live timeline events

state.description: Updated agent state, applied as a change against the fire-time snapshot

cycle.description: The cycle record appended to the agent timeline

tokens.description: Token usage of the cycle, when the model reported it

turns.description: Conversation turns the harness appended live, when any

frames.description: Session frame stack after the cycle, when the harness owns frames
